A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a mixture of 28 environmental chemicals administered to rats at low doses for three months resulted in a number of adverse effects on health, including changes to the metabolome, which may have implications for human health.

a low dose mixture of 27 environmental chemicals administered for three months in male juvenile rats can induce effects on weight and liver histology and that the effects on the metabolome can be used for biomonitoring of exposure.
a low-dose mixture of environmental chemicals administered for three months to male juvenile rats caused adverse effects in the liver, kidneys and blood plasma metabolome.

exposure to a low-dose mixture of environmental chemicals can cause adverse effects, including effects on the blood plasma metabolomic fingerprint.
